blurb:
Reef Snorkel + Sandbar & Sunset Sail 

• Summer Only with Small Groups on an Honest Eco Tour. 

What Makes this Eco Tour different?

• Guided Snorkeling 
Your mate hops in the water with you and points out animals and shows you the best spots, ensuring you and your loved ones get the best experience on your tour. 

• Small Groups
With a max group size of 24 guests and the warm calm weather of summer, you will see what makes an Honest Eco tour great for your group. 

Who is this trip for? 

We are a small family owned business, started by a biologist to offer authentic experiences that we would want to book. 

• We cater to Couples and Families who want a nature experience and would prefer to avoid the packed party boats. 

What is the Boat? 
The boat is a wide open 42' sailing catamaran that immerses you in the nature experience. It has a head on board, and we offer Fresh Organic Fruit and Filtered Water, Safety equipment and really good snorkeling gear.
